Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com: An article about the latest job report showing unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery nestled in the heart of the city, renowned for its authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional Swiss dishes including savory cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and delectable chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors adorned with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere. Guests can enjoy stunning panoramic views of the city skyline through large windows. Friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire ensure every visit feels like a delightful journey to the Swiss Alps.
